newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman bourse focused on bank, investment firm shares.
newsitem.headline: Oman bourse focused on bank, investment firm shares.

text.p: Trade on Oman's stock exchange was active in the week to Wednesday with buying interest focused on banks and investment company shares, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market index closed 0.7 points higher at 186.06 points from last week's 185.36.
Bank shares accounted for 67 percent of total trading value of 4.30 million rials from 10.6 million rials a week earlier.
Of the 57 companies traded in the week, shares of 25 rose, 14 fell and 18 were unchanged.
